meta.title: Honey Beauty Salon — Beauty, kissed by honey
meta.description: Premium beauty salon in Chișinău. Manicure, pedicure, lashes, brows, makeup and hair. Book online in seconds.

hero.title: Beauty, kissed by <gold>honey</gold>
hero.subtitle: Refined treatments, expert hands and an atmosphere made for slowing down. At Honey, every detail is for you.

about.title: A salon designed with care, for you
about.p1: At Honey Beauty Salon we believe beauty is a ritual — a moment that's yours alone, when you stop, breathe and feel beautiful. Our team blends classic techniques with modern trends, using premium products and tools sterilised to the highest standards.
about.p2: Whether you drop in for a quick manicure or want a full look for a special occasion, you'll walk out glowing.

trihologie.title: Trichology
trihologie.description: Scalp and hair diagnostics, mesotherapy, ozone therapy and hair-loss protocols — the science of healthy hair.

subItems.consultDiagnosisDesc: Scalp and hair fibre analysis, full anamnesis, and personalised care recommendations.
subItems.tricoscopyDesc: Detailed examination with a digital microscope — measuring density, thickness and scalp/hair health.
subItems.maintenanceDesc: Professional scalp cleansing, hydration and stimulation, plus therapeutic masks and lotions.
subItems.hairLossProtocolDesc: Personalised programme based on diagnosis: intensive professional treatment, trichology massage and targeted stimulation.
subItems.mesotherapyDesc: Microdosed injections of vitamins and peptides that stimulate growth and reduce hair loss.
subItems.ozoneDesc: Scalp oxygenation and detoxification — ideal for sebum control and circulation.
subItems.onlineConsultDesc: Remote consultation with treatment and product recommendations.

testimonials.title: What our clients say
testimonials.subtitle: We're proud of every kind word. Here's a selection from our Google reviews.

elenaCornita.name: Elena Corniță
elenaCornita.text: I warmly recommend Honey Salon! A very pleasant and warm atmosphere, and the technician was extremely attentive and professional. I felt great throughout the entire visit and left super happy. I'll definitely be back!

adrianaGrecu.name: Adriana Grecu
adrianaGrecu.text: A new salon with modern design. Everything is so aesthetic and well planned. From the first minutes you feel relaxed and looked after, which is so important for a woman stepping into a beauty salon. A very empathetic and warm team for every client. During the manicure I received a foot massage with a specialised device, which is wow for the Chișinău market! I'll happily return and recommend!

igorRailean.name: Igor Railean
igorRailean.text: Best barber services in this area!

courses.sectionSubtitle: Private 1-on-1 courses with Honey trainers. Learn the technique, mindset and confidence — at your own pace.

selfMakeup.title: Self Make-up Course
selfMakeup.intro: The course is delivered one-on-one so you get the trainer's full attention and master every step correctly. The results show immediately — you leave satisfied, confident and sure of your new skills.
selfMakeup.learn1: We work with our professional materials — everything is ready for you.
selfMakeup.learn2: We develop your technique, attitude and confidence in the makeup process.
selfMakeup.learn3: You'll create 4 types of makeup: day, evening, event, and photo/video.
selfMakeup.learn4: You'll learn how to choose the right products, colours and textures for your skin tone.
selfMakeup.learn5: You receive personalised feedback and corrections throughout each session.
selfMakeup.why1: Intensive 3-day programme — perfect for busy women.
selfMakeup.why2: Work one-on-one with the trainer — all the focus is on you.
selfMakeup.why3: All products are included — no hidden costs.
selfMakeup.why4: Visible results from day one: learn to do your own makeup correctly and in your personal style.
